typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT \'Anthem_MYNEXUS_Claims_\'+  RIGHT(\'0\' + CAST(DatePart(YYYY, DateAdd(mm, -1, getdate())) AS VARCHAR), 4)+   Right(\'0\' + CAST(DatePart(mm, DateAdd(mm, -1, getdate())) AS VARCHAR), 2)+   \'.txt\'+\'|\'+ CAST((select COUNT(1) from  ##TEMP_MYNEXUS_FINALREPORT) AS VARCHAR)+\'|\' as \'DataFileName\'',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		DataFileName as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		DataFileName)) ~> FlatFileDestination
